Subject: Stonebridge POC — evaluation summary, exec readout & decision path

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. I promised a concise recap of the POC outcomes, the evaluation plan we agreed, and the proposed next steps for the executive readout and contracting path. See below.

POC summary (high level):
- Duration: 3 weeks (9/10–9/30) running on Redwood Dedicated test cluster.
- Focus: clinical triage prompt set (50 prompts) + embeddings for search across 5000 internal notes.
- Key wins: 95% coverage on retrieval recall target, median generation latency 180ms for 512 tokens, 12% cost reduction with prefix caching config vs baseline.
- Items remaining: a small failure mode on long-thread context ( > 2,500 tokens) that Rishi is triaging.

Success criteria (agreed):
1) Accuracy: >= 90% on the clinical triage benchmark (we measured 92% on the sample set).
2) Latency SLO: median < 200ms at 95th pct for standard queries.
3) Cost: projected per-encounter inference cost <= $0.15 after caching and batching.
4) Security: data residency in us-east-1 + SOC2 evidence provided.

Evaluation plan and ownership:
- Stonebridge technical lead: Samir Khan — lead on user acceptance and executive readout.
- Procurement: Emily Park — ownership of procurement timeline and contract gating.
- Redwood: Ben (sales) — commercial; Monica (CS) — onboarding / success plan; Rishi (SE) — technical validation and open action items; Laura (legal) — contract redlines.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
1) Oct 3: Redwood sends final POC summary PDF and evaluation matrix (attached).
2) Oct 6–8: Stonebridge exec readout window. Suggest a 30–45m slot (Samir + VP Clinical Ops + Emily).
3) Oct 9: Redwood to deliver draft commercial terms + initial SOW; Laura will share a short-term order form for review.
4) Oct 17: Target go/no-go decision. If green, procurement begins signature flow week of Oct 20.

Attachments included: stonebridge_poc_summary.pdf and evaluation_matrix.xlsx.

Can you confirm: 1) who will present in the exec readout from Stonebridge, and 2) which date/time windows (Oct 6–8) work best?

Thanks — appreciate the partnership.

Ben
Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

- Confirmed: the technical results look good relative to our bar; the long-thread edge case is the only tech item we want fully mitigated before sign.
- Exec readout: I will present and invite our VP Clinical Operations (Dr. Priya Rao) and our CTO (Marcus Lin). Emily will confirm procurement attendance.
- Dates: Oct 7 morning (10:00–10:45 PT) is best for our execs. Can Redwood hold that slot?

On the decision path: our internal committee prefers a single readout and a consolidated go/no-go on Oct 17. If we vote go, procurement will request a quote against a 12-month committed capacity (we may need a reserved capacity SKU). I copied procurement so they can prep any SOW/PO template needs.

Also: can you send a redlineable term sheet and a ballpark ARR range for the committed SKU before Oct 9? That will help speed procurement.

Samir

Ben / Monica — confirmed. Quick technical update: 
- Root cause: KV cache truncation edge with > 2,500 token concatenated threads when system merges streamed segments. Repro on our internal harness in 2 hrs.
- Mitigation plan: (1) short-term: apply a config to cap prefix merging at 2,048 tokens and send guidance; (2) medium-term: fix in runtime that preserves chunk boundaries (PR target Oct 9).
- I'll attach the repro log and a short runbook snippet to Monica for the readout.

Rishi
